// diagnostic

E2476

Live query watch refused for `{query}`

What

Live query watch refused for `{query}`

Why

The live-query contract requires a `data.track` source and rejects callbacks or plans whose effects or numeric laws cannot be replayed safely.

Fix

Use `data.track(rows, row -> key)` before `query(...).watch()`, and avoid effectful callbacks or unsafe Float reassociation.
